svg.title: 六个免费公开数据源
svg.desc: 2026-10-31 快照中各免费公开数据源的行数横向柱状图。openFDA 器械 510(k): 176,466 rows, 1976→2026; openFDA 器械召回: 59,646 rows, 2002→2026; openFDA 器械 PMA: 57,372 rows, 1968→2026; ClinicalTrials.gov v2: 55,592 rows, 1999→2026; SEC EDGAR 8-K 语料: 20,976 rows, 2015→2026; openFDA 药品批准: 5,326 rows, 1966→2026. Total 375,378 rows.
